grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, butter, carrots, cheddar, egg, milk and thyme are all plain kitchen staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any Tesco at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, grater, knife and baking tray, and rubbing in and patting out a scone round is beginner technique.

works.reason: The flour to fat to liquid balance is sound once the moist carrot is counted, 220°C suits scones, and 8 wedges is a fair snack for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers grating the carrots and cheese, rubbing in and shaping, and the 28 cook minutes match the 18-minute bake plus 10 minutes of cooling.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and the dusting flour comes from the flour already listed.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm carrot and cheese scones suit a late October afternoon, and the grated carrot runs through the dough rather than sitting on top as a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, homely British English with nothing fancy or preachy.

hearty_healthy.reason: A savoury scone with carrot, cheese and egg is a filling snack a family would make again.
